summary: Rebase with git pull --rebase upstream devel, resolve any conflicts, and ignore git status's divergence message and its suggestion to git pull.
questions: What command rebases my branch on the latest devel?
git status says my branch has diverged after rebasing; is that a problem?

answer_card.title: Rebase your branch
answer_card.answer_md:
```shell-session
$ git pull --rebase upstream devel
```
Resolve conflicts if prompted. Afterwards `git status` will say your branch and `origin` have diverged; that's normal. **Don't** run `git pull` as it suggests.
